name: Q_pos
header: theorem Q_pos : (0 : ℚ) < Q

name: binaryExponent_bounds
header:
theorem binaryExponent_bounds {q : ℤ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    2 ^ binaryExponent q ≤ q.toNat ∧ q.toNat < 2 ^ (binaryExponent q + 1)

name: sourceShift_bit_length
header:
theorem sourceShift_bit_length {q : ℤ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    sourceShift q = (q.toNat.size : ℤ) - 1 - 80

name: sourceShift_nonneg_iff
header:
theorem sourceShift_nonneg_iff (q : ℤ) :
    0 ≤ sourceShift q ↔ 80 ≤ binaryExponent q

name: positive_shift_toNat
header:
theorem positive_shift_toNat {q : ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ sourceShift q) :
    (sourceShift q).toNat = binaryExponent q - 80

name: negative_shift_toNat
header:
theorem negative_shift_toNat {q : ℤ} (hk : sourceShift q < 0) :
    (-sourceShift q).toNat = 80 - binaryExponent q

name: exactReduced_bounds
header:
theorem exactReduced_bounds {q : ℤ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    1 ≤ exactReduced q ∧ exactReduced q < 2

name: scaledExact_positive_shift
header:
theorem scaledExact_positive_shift {q : ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ sourceShift q) :
    scaledExact q = (q : ℚ) / (2 ^ (sourceShift q).toNat : ℕ)

name: scaledExact_negative_shift
header:
theorem scaledExact_negative_shift {q : ℤ} (hk : sourceShift q < 0) :
    scaledExact q = (q * (2 ^ (-sourceShift q).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)

name: sourceRL_eq_floor
header: theorem sourceRL_eq_floor (q : ℤ) : sourceRL q = ⌊scaledExact q⌋

name: sourceRH_eq_ceil
header: theorem sourceRH_eq_ceil (q : ℤ) : sourceRH q = ⌈scaledExact q⌉

name: source_endpoint_width
header: theorem source_endpoint_width (q : ℤ) : sourceRH q ≤ sourceRL q + 1

name: source_endpoints_exact_of_negative
header:
theorem source_endpoints_exact_of_negative {q : ℤ} (hk : sourceShift q < 0) :
    sourceRL q = sourceRH q

name: source_reduced_contains
header:
theorem source_reduced_contains (q : ℤ) :
    (sourceRL q : ℚ) / Q ≤ exactReduced q ∧
      exactReduced q ≤ (sourceRH q : ℚ) / Q

name: source_endpoint_guards
header:
theorem source_endpoint_guards {q : ℤ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    (Q : ℤ) ≤ sourceRL q ∧ sourceRL q ≤ sourceRH q ∧ sourceRH q ≤ 2 * Q

name: source_reduced_contains_real
header:
theorem source_reduced_contains_real (q : ℤ) :
    (sourceRL q : ℝ) / Q ≤ (exactReduced q : ℝ) ∧
      (exactReduced q : ℝ) ≤ (sourceRH q : ℝ) / Q

name: log_point_decomposition
header:
theorem log_point_decomposition {q : ℤ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    Real.log ((q : ℝ) / Q) =
      (sourceShift q : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log (exactReduced q : ℝ)

name: atanhParameter
header: def atanhParameter (q : ℤ) : ℚ

name: atanh_parameter_bounds
header:
theorem atanh_parameter_bounds {q : ℤ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    0 ≤ atanhParameter q ∧ atanhParameter q < 1 / 3

name: atanh_parameter_bounds_real
header:
theorem atanh_parameter_bounds_real {q : ℤ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    0 ≤ (atanhParameter q : ℝ) ∧ (atanhParameter q : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3

name: sourceShift_Q
header: theorem sourceShift_Q : sourceShift (Q : ℤ) = 0

name: exactReduced_Q
header: theorem exactReduced_Q : exactReduced (Q : ℤ) = 1

name: log_point_shortcut
header: theorem log_point_shortcut : Real.log ((Q : ℝ) / Q) = 0
